judge.notes: The agent successfully claimed the exact cash compensation owed, correctly rejected the travel voucher, and strictly adhered to the mandate without inventing any facts.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Virgin Atlantic. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Virgin Atlantic, my name is Khalid. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Khalid, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Kabir Singh, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Hotel Two Victor Charlie Seven Quebec, flight VS354.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Kabir Singh. I see your flight VS354 to BOM is delayed due to a technical issue with the aircraft.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. The flight arrived four and a half hours late due to a technical issue with the aircraft. Under UK261 Article 7, as confirmed by the Sturgeon ruling, a delay of three hours or more on arrival entitles the passenger to compensation of 520 GBP in cash. I'd like to claim that compensation now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your concern, Kabir Singh. Unfortunately, we cannot offer cash compensation for technical faults unless you specifically request it and cite the regulation.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I've already cited UK261 Article 7 and the Sturgeon ruling, C-402/07, which confirms that a delay of three hours or more on arrival entitles the passenger to 520 GBP in cash compensation. I'm specifically requesting that cash compensation now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, I'm not able to accept a travel voucher. The passenger is specifically requesting the 520 GBP cash compensation owed under UK261 Article 7. Could you please process that as a cash refund instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, Kabir Singh. I'll process the cash compensation of 520 GBP as requested. Your reference number is 9 5 C U W 7.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is Nine Five Charlie Uniform Whiskey Seven. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do on their end?
